items.title: Shopify Dropship Automation SaaS Build
items.description:
E-Store Manager

E-Store Manager is a multi-tenant Shopify app designed to automate product discovery, fulfillment, marketing, and customer service for dropshipping stores operating on an Amazon FBA-style fulfillment model — where products are sold on the merchant’s own Shopify storefront but fulfilled and shipped through Amazon’s fulfillment network rather than traditional slow-ship dropshipping.

What it does

Product Discovery
A discovery engine identifies best-selling products within a given niche — surfacing what’s already proven to sell well, rather than speculative bulk-buy bets. It pulls data from:

	•	CJdropshipping — product search, pricing, order creation, and tracking via their API

	•	AutoDS — automated product search/import, with one-way push to Shopify

	•	DSers — AliExpress-sourced catalog, synced through the DSers UI into Shopify

Products are ranked using signals like sales velocity/demand, margin, trend momentum (Google Trends, public TikTok signals), customer rating, and market saturation within the niche — without scraping restricted sources like Amazon bestseller pages. The goal is to tell the merchant “these are the winning products in your niche right now,” so they can decide which to add to their store.

Product Import & Sync
Once a merchant selects products from the discovery results, they’re imported into their Shopify store via the Shopify Admin API, with supplier metadata (source, cost, shipping time) tagged for later routing.

Fulfillment — Amazon FBA Focused
Instead of routing every order back to the original supplier for one-off shipping, the app treats Amazon as the primary fulfillment warehouse.

	•	Merchant-owned inventory that has been shipped into Amazon’s warehouses is fulfilled via the Amazon SP-API (Multi-Channel Fulfillment / MCF) when a Shopify order comes in — Amazon picks, packs, and ships the order using its own logistics network, even though the sale happened on Shopify.

	•	Products not yet stocked at Amazon can fall back to standard supplier-side fulfillment via CJdropshipping/AutoDS/DSers.

	•	The routing layer decides per-order which path to use based on whether FBA stock exists for that SKU.

Marketing
AI-generated marketing copy (product descriptions, ad copy, social posts) is drafted for each product, but always requires human approval before publishing — no autonomous posting.

Customer Service
AI-drafted responses to common customer inquiries (order status, returns, product questions — including FBA-specific questions like Amazon-handled shipping/tracking), again with a human-in-the-loop review step rather than fully autonomous replies.

Multi-Tenancy
The app is built to manage multiple independent Shopify stores from a single instance, with per-store OAuth sessions, isolated data, and separate supplier/FBA inventory configurations for each tenant.

How it works (architecture)

	1. 	Shopify OAuth — each store installs the app and authorizes access; sessions and tokens are stored per-tenant.

	2. 	Discovery Engine — periodically queries supplier APIs and market-signal sources, identifies top-selling products per niche, scores them, and stores candidates for merchant review.

	3. 	Import Layer — approved products are written to Shopify via the Admin API, with supplier source and FBA-stock status tagged in metadata.

	4. 	Order/Fulfillment Webhooks — Shopify order events trigger routing logic: if the SKU has FBA inventory, the order is dispatched to Amazon via SP-API/MCF; otherwise it falls back to supplier dropship fulfillment.

	5. 	Marketing & CS Modules — generate drafts, hold them in a review queue, and only push/send after merchant approval.

	6. 	Data Layer — a relational schema tracks stores, sessions, discovered products (with niche/bestseller signals), imported products, FBA inventory levels, orders, line items, and fulfillment status/source, enabling reporting and reconciliation across tenants.

Skills: PHP, Python, iPhone, Amazon Web Services, Shopify, Dropshipping, API Development, SaaS Development

items.title: My Square Feet
items.description:
MY SQUARE FEET

Real Estate Property Marketplace App — Development Requirement

1. ऐप का उद्देश्य

My Square Feet एक रियल एस्टेट प्लेटफॉर्म होगा, जहाँ कोई भी व्यक्ति अपनी प्लॉट, मकान, दुकान, जमीन या अन्य प्रॉपर्टी को बहुत आसानी से फोटो और वीडियो के साथ अपलोड कर सकेगा।

इस ऐप का मुख्य उद्देश्य है:

“प्रॉपर्टी को जल्दी लिस्ट करें, खरीदार तक पहुँचाएँ और Buyer तथा Seller के बीच संपर्क My Square Feet के माध्यम से कराएँ।”

---

2. ऐप के मुख्य यूज़र

Buyer

जो व्यक्ति प्रॉपर्टी खरीदना चाहता है।

Seller

जो व्यक्ति अपनी प्रॉपर्टी बेचना चाहता है।

My Square Feet Admin/Team

कंपनी जो Buyer और Seller के बीच संपर्क की पूरी प्रक्रिया संभालेगी।

---

3. सबसे महत्वपूर्ण USP

Buyer और Seller आपस में सीधे संपर्क नहीं करेंगे।

न तो Buyer को Seller का मोबाइल नंबर दिखाई देगा और न Seller को Buyer का मोबाइल नंबर।

संपर्क का मॉडल:

Buyer → My Square Feet → Seller

और

Seller → My Square Feet → Buyer

My Square Feet एक इंटरमीडिएट/मध्यस्थ के रूप में काम करेगा।

---

4. कॉल सिस्टम

जब Buyer किसी प्रॉपर्टी पर “My Square Feet से संपर्क करें” बटन दबाएगा, तो कॉल My Square Feet के कंपनी नंबर या कॉलिंग सिस्टम पर आएगी।

इसके बाद My Square Feet की टीम Seller से संपर्क करेगी और Buyer की आवश्यकता के अनुसार बातचीत कराएगी।

इसी तरह Seller भी Buyer से सीधे संपर्क नहीं कर पाएगा।

जरूरी नियम:

- Buyer का नंबर Seller को नहीं दिखे।
- Seller का नंबर Buyer को नहीं दिखे।
- Buyer और Seller के बीच Direct Call न हो।
- Buyer और Seller के बीच Chat न हो।
- Buyer और Seller के बीच Direct Video Call न हो।
- पूरा संपर्क My Square Feet के माध्यम से हो।

---

5. Home Screen

Home Screen पर:

MY SQUARE FEET

Search Bar:
“प्रॉपर्टी खोजें — स्थान, कीमत, क्षेत्रफल…”

Property Categories:

- प्लॉट
- मकान
- दुकान
- जमीन
- फ्लैट
- कमर्शियल प्रॉपर्टी
- अन्य

Location:

यूज़र अपना शहर या स्थान चुन सके।

उदाहरण:

हल्द्वानी

Property Cards में:

- मुख्य फोटो या वीडियो
- प्रॉपर्टी का प्रकार
- कीमत
- क्षेत्रफल
- स्थान
- फ्रंट × गहराई
- रोड की चौड़ाई
- दिशा
- छोटा विवरण
- “My Square Feet से संपर्क करें” बटन

---

6. Property Detail Screen

किसी प्रॉपर्टी पर क्लिक करने के बाद:

ऊपर:

- प्रॉपर्टी का वीडियो
- फोटो गैलरी

नीचे:

मुख्य बटन:

बटन के नीचे स्पष्ट संदेश:

“आपकी निजी जानकारी सुरक्षित रहेगी। खरीदार और विक्रेता का सीधा संपर्क उपलब्ध नहीं कराया जाएगा।”

---

7. Seller Registration

Seller मोबाइल नंबर और OTP से रजिस्टर करेगा।

इसके बाद:

यह नंबर सार्वजनिक प्रोफाइल पर दिखाई नहीं देगा।

---

8. Property Upload

यह ऐप का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण फीचर होगा।

“30 सेकंड के अंदर प्रॉपर्टी लिस्ट करना।”

- क्षेत्रफल
- फ्रंट
- गहराई
- रोड

छोटा विवरण।

Step 5

---

9. Fast Upload

ऐप का Property Upload सिस्टम बहुत सरल और कम क्लिक वाला होना चाहिए।

लक्ष्य यह होना चाहिए कि Seller वीडियो, फोटो और जरूरी जानकारी डालकर लगभग 30 सेकंड में Listing तैयार कर सके।

भविष्य में वीडियो और फोटो के आधार पर कुछ जानकारी अपने आप भरने की सुविधा भी जोड़ी जा सकती है।

---

items.title: Hydro Excavation Mobile Game
items.description:
I’m ready to turn my hydro-excavation concept into a fully playable mobile title for iOS and Android. The player will operate a vacuum truck and high-pressure water lance, carefully uncovering buried cables and pipes without damaging them. I need realistic visuals—wet soil, pressurised water, mud flow, and metallic utilities should all look and behave convincingly on touch screens.

Core gameplay combines three pillars:  
• Time-based missions that reward fast yet careful digging.  
• Puzzle-style decision making—choose where to probe, adjust water pressure, brace trenches, and route suction hoses.  
• Exploration and discovery across procedurally arranged job sites, from quiet suburbs to busy industrial corridors.

Please build with a mobile-friendly engine such as Unity or Unreal, implementing real-time erosion, particle effects, and physics that still run smoothly on mid-range phones. I’ll need:

1. A tutorial yard teaching nozzle control and utility detection.  
2. At least two mission maps featuring varied soil layers and randomly placed electrical, fibre, and gas lines.  
3. UI/UX that works in portrait and landscape, with touch controls for water flow, suction, and camera pan/zoom.  
4. Optimised APK and IPA builds plus full documented source so I can add new levels later.

If you’ve tackled realistic physics, fluid simulation, or construction-themed games on mobile, I’d love to see your work. Let’s dig in!

items.title: ROS 2 AMR – Motor, LiDAR SLAM & Autonomous Navigation Integration
items.description:
I have a differential-drive autonomous mobile robot running ROS 2 and need the whole motion stack stitched together around a pair of Nidec motors driven by an FBL2360TE controller. Your first task will be bringing that controller and its quadrature encoders cleanly into ROS 2 so accurate wheel odometry publishes through TF.  

From there the sensing layer comes in: a 2-D LiDAR already mounted and producing good scans. I plan to build the map with SLAM Toolbox, so the integration work must ensure scan topics, transforms and static frames are perfectly aligned for reliable loop-closure.  

The biggest hurdle I anticipate is Nav2 autonomous navigation; path planning, obstacle avoidance and localization must run smoothly on-board with minimal CPU overhead. Once the stack is functional in simulation, we will move to the physical robot for tuning—PID on the FBL2360TE, inflation parameters, recovery behaviors, velocity limits and safety checks.  

Deliverables  
• ROS 2 nodes or launch files that interface the FBL2360TE, publish /cmd_vel and encoder odometry, and broadcast TF frames.  
• SLAM Toolbox configuration producing a consistent map in our warehouse environment.  
• Fully configured Nav2 stack demonstrating live localization, global & local path planning and dynamic obstacle avoidance.  
• Step-by-step test procedure and final real-world validation video or bag files showing a complete autonomous run.  

Hands-on experience with ROS 2, TF2, encoder math, Nav2 tuning and, ideally, the Nidec/FBL2360TE hardware will let you move quickly. If that sounds like your skill set, let’s start building.

I’m producing a short-form educational video series covering key battles and conflicts throughout military history. Each episode will run approximately 2–5 minutes and should feel authoritative, visually polished, and engaging for a broad online audience.

I’m looking for someone who can handle the full production workflow from research through final delivery, with the potential for a long-term collaboration if the work meets expectations. The goal is to build a YouTube channel with consistent, high-quality content.

The work will include:

- End-to-end video production: research, scripting, AI visuals/animation, voiceover, editing, sound design, captions, color correction, thumbnail creation, and final 4K export.
- Historical research and accuracy: use credible sources, fact-check key claims, and flag uncertainty rather than inventing details.
- YouTube publishing and channel support: upload videos, add titles/descriptions/thumbnails/captions, schedule releases, apply correct disclosures, and check the final upload.
- Source and asset management: maintain a clear record of research sources, archival material, licenses, AI-generated assets, and project files.
- IP and ownership agreement: all original commissioned work and deliverables are assigned to me upon payment with rights to edit, republish, monetize, translate, license, and reuse.
- Third-party rights and licensing: freelancer is responsible for ensuring any stock materials (e.g., archive footage/music/fonts), AI outputs or subcontracted work can legally be used commercially.
- Confidentiality and account security: protect unreleased material, channel information/credentials/business details; use secure delegated access where possible.
- Deliverables and file handover: final videos plus editable project files (source assets/scripts/captions/thumbnails/audio/prompts/research/reference sheets).
- Payment milestones and revisions: agreed rate/delivery stages/turnaround times/revision limits/approval points.
- Quality control and corrections: freelancer must check factual accuracy/captions/audio/visual consistency/export quality/fix errors they introduced.
- Termination and handover: clear process for ending the relationship/transferring all files/removing account access/handing over unfinished work.
- Independent contractor agreement: covers responsibilities/liability/confidentiality/IP/governing law/limits on subcontracting or spending without approval.

Additional Notes:

- An initial discussion session will be required to align on expectations, workflow processes, and desired output. Example videos I have produced myself will be provided during this session as references.
- A trial is required: freelancers will need to produce the first 30 seconds or 1 minute of an episode to demonstrate their capability before proceeding with the full video.
- Oversight will be provided on scripts/assets during initial stages. Once the freelancer gets it right consistently over time they may manage production independently.

The key priorities are historical accuracy, strong storytelling, realistic visuals, consistency in quality across episodes, professional presentation. The final result should feel closer to a high-quality television or premium YouTube history documentary than generic AI-generated content.

If a viewer can learn something meaningful in under five minutes and the finished episode looks polished enough to broadcast or upload professionally on YouTube channels aimed at broad audiences interested in history documentaries—this project has succeeded.

When applying: please include examples of relevant documentary work (history/military), AI-video production samples if available (or similar short-form editing work), along with the AI/editing tools you normally use.

Skills: Research, Sound Design, Video Production, Video Editing, Color Grading, Script Writing, AI Content Creation, AI Research, AI Video Editing, AI Voiceover

*Initiative: Sentinel Ledger — Real-Time FinTech Risk Intelligence & Anomaly Surveillance Platform (Backend Engineering)*

We are seeking a senior systems architect or technical team to design, build, containerize, and operate the production backend for a real-time anomaly detection and threat-scoring platform for financial transactions.

This is not a proof-of-concept or an experimental sandbox. The final deliverable must be a fully hardened, real-time, fault-tolerant system built to run in live enterprise environments.

*System Overview*
The backend framework must:
- Ingest and process high-velocity transaction data continuously and without lag
- Detect irregular behavior using trained machine learning models, not static or hardcoded heuristics
- Publish live threat-assessment metrics through fast, low-latency endpoints
- Meet demanding throughput, response-time, and scaling requirements

Placeholder code, hardcoded logic, synthetic mock data, or simulated streaming endpoints will be treated as an automatic project default.

*Compensation & Milestone Schedule — GBP 2,300 Fixed, Paid in Two Stages*

_Stage 1 — GBP 2,185_
Released when the contract begins. Covers cloud resources, environment setup, and the initial core pipeline build.
Note: this payment is not delivery, review, or approval of the work. It does not waive any technical spec, throughput standard, or runtime target, and it does not limit legal recourse or clawback rights if the contract is breached.

_Stage 2 — GBP 115 (Final Settlement)_
Released only once:
- Production go-live is complete, end to end
- All microservices are active and reachable
- Latency and throughput metrics have been verified
- Full handover has taken place: source repos, model weights/artifacts, cloud/infra credentials, technical/architecture docs

If exit criteria aren't met, final payment is forfeited.

*What Needs to Get Built*
Leave out any piece below and the whole delivery counts as failed.

_Data Intake_
- Distributed streaming, running on Kafka and Spark Streaming
- Handles serious payload volume without falling behind, in real time
- Schema checks, cleanup, and validation baked into the pipeline itself

_Feature Engineering_
- One central place where computed features live
- Real-time streaming and offline batch computation running side by side

_Detection & Scoring_
- Anomaly detection that mixes statistical boundaries with recurrent LSTM models
- A weighted service that blends multiple models into one threat score
- Model inference that returns results in well under a second
- Fixed rule filters, hardcoded thresholds, or canned static responses won't cut it here.

_Making Predictions Explainable_
- SHAP-based explainability (or something equivalent)
- A plain-language reason attached to every score the model produces

_API & Application Layer_
- Built on FastAPI, organized into clean modules
- OAuth2/JWT handles enterprise authentication
- Structured to run as standalone microservices
- Complete OpenAPI/Swagger docs for anyone consuming the API downstream

_Infrastructure & DevOps_
- Kubernetes running across multiple nodes
- CI/CD automated end to end for builds and releases
- Grafana and Prometheus covering telemetry, logging, and observability
- Canary or blue-green deploys for safe rollouts
- A script that only runs locally, a docker-compose setup with no real scaling path, or anything that can't handle production traffic gets disqualified.

_Testing & QA_
- Load and concurrency testing pushed to peak volume
- A formal readiness check signed off before anything goes live

*Mandatory Performance Benchmarks*
The architecture must meet or exceed every one of these:
- Ingestion Rate: ≥ 50,000 events/sec
- Pipeline Latency: ≤ 2.0 seconds
- Feature Lookup: ≤ 50 milliseconds
- Model Precision: ≥ 90% true-positive anomaly rate
- Inference Compute Time: ≤ 80 milliseconds
- API Round-Trip Response: ≤ 400 milliseconds

Missing a single benchmark constitutes non-delivery.

*Uptime & Reliability*
99.5% uptime, tracked monthly. Usual carve-outs apply — scheduled maintenance, third-party vendor outages, force majeure, or unauthorized changes.

*Support Coverage*
Hours: 09:00–18:00 GMT/BST
- Sev 1 (everything's down): triage within 4 hrs, patched within 24 hrs
- Sev 2 (major functionality broken): triage within 8 hrs, patched within 48 hrs
- Sev 3 (small issue): triage within 1 business day, resolved within 5

*When Is This Actually Done?*
Sign-off happens only when, all at once:
- It's live and running in a real cloud environment
- Every listed component is up and checked
- The models are giving real predictions, not sample output
- Latency and throughput hold up under actual load
- CI/CD and monitoring are working
- Architecture docs and runbooks delivered
- Credentials, repos, and model files fully handed over

Half-finished doesn't count as finished here.

*Security, Governance & Regulatory Compliance*
Must follow safeguards aligned with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and applicable PCI-DSS standards. All pipelines must comply with UK/EU GDPR. Anonymized, non-attributable data may be used only where legally permitted.

*Intellectual Property Rights*
Once the final milestone is released, all custom code, model weights, config scripts, and documentation transfer entirely to the Employer. Developer keeps prior rights to their own internal boilerplate, generic scaffolding, and reusable provisioning utilities. Employer retains exclusive ownership of all proprietary data and live streams.

*Non-Disclosure & Confidentiality*
Both parties keep confidential: platform architecture, data workflows/models, live payloads, secrets, and system configs. This obligation stays in force indefinitely after the contract ends.

*Default, Breach & Recourse*
Failing to deliver a fully tested, production-grade platform is a material breach — missed deadlines, broken/incomplete services, unmet performance thresholds, or inability to run live in production. Employer can cancel the engagement and seek full restitution of paid funds under governing law.

*Right to Suspend Work*
Developer may pause work if invoices go unpaid beyond 30 days, Employer breaches core terms, misuse/tampering is uncovered, or an imminent security vulnerability threatens the build.

*Liability Bounds*
Standard statutory liability limits apply. Nothing here limits liability for death/personal injury from negligence, deliberate fraud/misrepresentation, or non-waivable statutory duties.

*Unforeseen Events (Force Majeure)*
Neither party is responsible for delays from events outside reasonable control: natural disasters, armed conflict, grid/telecom blackouts, state-level emergencies or epidemics.

*Communication & Governance Channels*
All official communication must go through Upwork platform channels. Off-platform commitments carry no contractual weight.

*Legal Framework*
Governed exclusively by the laws of England and Wales; disputes subject to the sole jurisdiction of its courts.

*Zero Partial-Acceptance Policy*
Piecemeal or fractional work won't be accepted. No partial payment for semi-functional builds. "Near complete," "pre-alpha," or "beta-grade" submissions rejected. No prorated payouts for individual working modules. Test-suite access or interim feedback ≠ formal acceptance. Acceptance is binary and requires 100% production completion.

*Candidate Prerequisites*
- Proven track record shipping high-availability distributed backends to production
- Hands-on mastery of high-throughput streaming architectures
- Experience containerizing and serving scalable ML systems
- Deep operational fluency with Kafka, Spark, Kubernetes, and FastAPI

*Submission Checklist*
- Case studies of live production builds (not demos/sandboxes)
- High-level technical design proposal
- Team layout/resource allocation (if bidding as an agency)
- Milestone-based delivery timeline

*Final Directive*
This engagement requires enterprise-tier systems engineering. Anything short of a fully deployed, high-throughput, production-ready platform will be marked as non-performance and unfulfilled delivery.

items.title: Build ML Anomaly Detection Backend
items.description:
Sentinel Ledger: Real-Time Risk & Anomaly Intelligence Backend

THE ROLE

We're hiring a senior backend architect (or a small team, if bidding as an agency) to build a production-grade, real-time transaction-monitoring system from the ground up. This isn't a prototype or a portfolio piece — the end result needs to run live, under real load, in a real enterprise environment, with real money moving through it.

Transactions flow in continuously, get scored for risk in near-real-time by trained ML models, and surface actionable alerts through a fast, well-documented API — all while the whole stack stays observable, scalable, and secure.

We won't accept stubbed-out logic, hardcoded thresholds standing in for real models, mocked data streams, or anything that only works in a demo. If it can't survive production traffic, it doesn't count.

WHAT YOU'LL BE BUILDING

1. Ingestion Layer
- A distributed streaming pipeline (Kafka + Spark Streaming) that keeps pace with high transaction volume in real time, with no backlog buildup
- Validation, cleanup, and schema enforcement built directly into the pipeline, not bolted on after

2. Feature Store
- A single, centralized feature repository
- Streaming and batch feature computation running in parallel, kept consistent with each other

3. Detection & Scoring Engine
- Hybrid anomaly detection: statistical thresholds combined with a trained LSTM (recurrent) model — no static rule sets pretending to be ML
- An ensemble layer that blends model outputs into a single weighted threat score
- Sub-second inference, every time

4. Explainability Layer
- SHAP (or a comparable method) attached to every prediction
- A human-readable explanation accompanying each score, no black-box outputs

5. API Layer
- FastAPI, cleanly modularized by domain
- OAuth2/JWT for enterprise-grade auth
- Each major function deployable as its own microservice
- Full OpenAPI/Swagger documentation

6. Infrastructure
- Kubernetes, multi-node, production-configured
- Full CI/CD, no manual build/deploy steps
- Observability via Prometheus + Grafana (metrics, logs, alerting)
- Canary or blue-green rollout strategy
- Local-only setups or docker-compose without a real scaling path will not pass review

7. QA & Load Validation
- Load and concurrency testing at peak projected volume
- A formal go/no-go readiness review before anything touches production

PERFORMANCE BENCHMARKS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Ingestion throughput: 50,000+ events/sec
- End-to-end pipeline latency: 2.0 seconds or less
- Feature lookup time: 50 ms or less
- Model precision (true positives): 90% or higher
- Inference compute time: 80 ms or less
- API round-trip response: 400 ms or less

Missing any one of these means the deliverable isn't accepted.

Uptime target: 99.5%, measured monthly (standard exclusions apply: scheduled maintenance, third-party outages, force majeure, unauthorized changes).

POST-LAUNCH SUPPORT

Coverage window: 09:00 to 18:00 GMT/BST

Sev 1 (full outage): triage in 4 hours, resolved in 24 hours
Sev 2 (major feature broken): triage in 8 hours, resolved in 48 hours
Sev 3 (minor issue): triage in 1 business day, resolved in 5 business days

COMPENSATION

Total: £2,300 fixed, paid in two milestones

Milestone 1: £2,100, released at contract start to cover environment setup, cloud resources, and initial pipeline development. This payment does not constitute approval, sign-off, or a waiver of any technical requirement. All specs, benchmarks, and runtime targets in this brief remain fully in force regardless.

Milestone 2 (final settlement): £200, released only after full production go-live, all services verified active and meeting every latency/throughput benchmark, and complete handover (source code, model artifacts, credentials, and documentation). If exit criteria aren't met, this final payment is forfeited.

DEFINITION OF DONE

All of the following, simultaneously, no partial credit:
- Live in a real cloud environment, not a staging sandbox
- Every component listed above deployed and verified
- Models producing genuine predictions on real data
- Benchmarks holding under actual load, not synthetic tests
- CI/CD and monitoring fully operational
- Documentation and runbooks delivered
- All credentials, repositories, and model files transferred

Acceptance is binary. "Nearly done," "beta," and "mostly working" submissions are not accepted, and there's no prorated payment for partially completed modules.

COMPLIANCE & SECURITY

Must align with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and applicable PCI-DSS standards. All data handling must comply with UK/EU GDPR; synthetic or anonymized data may only be used where legally appropriate.

IP, CONFIDENTIALITY & LEGAL TERMS

IP transfer: Upon final payment, all custom code, models, configs, and documentation transfer fully to the Employer. The developer retains rights to any pre-existing generic tooling, boilerplate, or reusable infrastructure scripts not built specifically for this project.

Confidentiality: Indefinite, for both parties, covering architecture, workflows, models, live data, secrets, and configs.

Breach: Failure to deliver a fully functioning, benchmark-compliant production system is treated as material breach, entitling the Employer to terminate and seek recovery of funds paid.

Suspension rights: The developer may pause work for unpaid invoices (30+ days), Employer breach of core terms, discovered misuse, or an urgent unpatched security risk.

Liability: Standard statutory limits apply; no limitation on liability for death or injury from negligence, fraud, or non-waivable statutory duties.

Force majeure: Standard carve-outs for events outside either party's control.

Communication: All binding communication must occur through Freelancer.com; off-platform agreements carry no contractual weight.

Governing law: England and Wales, exclusive jurisdiction.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A demonstrated track record deploying high-availability distributed systems to production, not just prototypes
- Deep hands-on experience with high-throughput streaming architectures
- Experience containerizing and operating ML systems at scale
- Strong working knowledge of Kafka, Spark, Kubernetes, and FastAPI

TO APPLY, INCLUDE

- Case studies from real production deployments (sandboxes or demos won't count)
- A high-level technical design proposal

Acceptance criteria:
– No visual overlaps or broken grids at 320 px, 768 px, and 1440 px widths.  
– Consistent spacing and alignment across all affected components.  
– Lighthouse or similar audit shows “Layout Shift” issues resolved (green scores).

You will work solely in the React layer; Python back-end access is unnecessary. Once fixed, push a clean commit or deliver a zipped patch—whichever is easier for you.

I need a Python developer to craft a self-contained scraper inside a lightweight Django app for our client’s own website. Phase 1 is all about reliability and clarity, not bells and whistles.

Scope of work
• Create a fresh Django project with a single command (e.g., python manage.py scrape) that navigates the distributed pages of the site, gathers the required text-based content, and captures any embedded timestamps or IDs that help with later analysis.  
• Persist every record directly to the default SQLite database through Django models—no external queues, no Celery.  
• Make the scraper idempotent: re-running it should update or skip existing entries rather than duplicate them.  
• Keep the code modular and well-commented so we can swap in PostgreSQL and add scheduling in the next phase.  
• Deliver a concise README that covers environment setup, model definitions, and the command’s expected runtime.

Success looks like running one command and ending up with a clean, query-ready dataset our analysts can immediately explore.

If you have proven experience with Django, BeautifulSoup, Requests or similar libraries, and can meet these requirements quickly and cleanly, let’s talk timeline and hand-off details.

items.description:
DESARROLLO DE WEB APP B2B BILINGÜE CON IA, MOTOR DE REGLAS Y REPORTES EJECUTIVOS

Busco un desarrollador senior o un equipo pequeño para diseñar y construir el MVP de una Web App B2B enfocada en evaluar y priorizar oportunidades de mejora en decisiones de Supply Chain Planning.

La aplicación soportará una metodología propietaria y combinará recolección de información de varios stakeholders, evaluación de madurez, identificación de oportunidades, cálculos de valor y ROI, comparación multicriterio, análisis con inteligencia artificial, validación humana y reportes ejecutivos.

No se busca una página web, un cuestionario básico ni un chatbot genérico. Debe ser una aplicación con usuarios, organizaciones, engagements, reglas configurables, evidencia, trazabilidad y reportes.

La plataforma está abierta. Se aceptan propuestas con desarrollo tradicional, no-code, low-code o una combinación. El candidato deberá justificar su arquitectura considerando funcionalidad, seguridad, mantenimiento, escalabilidad, propiedad y costo total de operación.

ALCANCE DEL MVP

1. Diagnóstico público

Experiencia bilingüe y responsive de aproximadamente diez minutos:

• Preguntas dinámicas y lógica condicional.
• Captura de participante, empresa y consentimiento.
• Posibilidad de guardar y continuar.
• Resultado preliminar de madurez y señales de oportunidad.
• Presentación del resultado en pantalla y por correo.
• Registro del lead en el panel administrativo.
• Identificación de respuestas incompletas o inconsistentes.
• Scoring y routing interno.

El diagnóstico no produce una recomendación de inversión ni un business case completo.

2. Organizaciones, usuarios y permisos

La parte privada debe administrar organizaciones, engagements, usuarios internos y participantes del cliente. Cada engagement podrá incluir hasta cinco stakeholders.

Roles iniciales: administrador, analista interno, sponsor del cliente y stakeholder participante.

Se requiere autenticación segura, accesos según rol, asignación de secciones, guardado de avances, seguimiento de pendientes, consolidación de respuestas sin perder su fuente e historial de actividad.

3. Assessment guiado

El producto privado no será completamente self-service. El equipo interno facilitará cada engagement, cuya duración típica será cercana a dos semanas.

La aplicación debe permitir:

• Crear el engagement y definir su alcance.
• Seleccionar decisiones o casos de uso.
• Invitar stakeholders y asignar actividades.
• Utilizar un banco configurable de preguntas.
• Aplicar lógica condicional.
• Registrar notas de entrevistas.
• Solicitar aclaraciones.
• Cargar documentos PDF, Word y Excel.
• Asociar evidencia con preguntas, hallazgos u oportunidades.
• Registrar supuestos, vacíos, contradicciones y confianza.
• Controlar el estado y progreso.

No se requieren videoconferencias, grabación de reuniones ni integración con calendarios.

4. Motor de reglas, análisis y priorización

El cliente proporcionará la metodología, preguntas, fórmulas y criterios. El desarrollador deberá convertirlos en una solución configurable y mantenible.

El sistema debe soportar:

• Dimensiones y niveles de madurez.
• Scoring e identificación de brechas.
• Formulación de oportunidades.
• Mecanismos de generación de valor.
• Escenarios bajo, base y alto.
• Cálculos de ROI y payback.
• Criterios, pesos y reglas de exclusión.
• Priorización de hasta cinco oportunidades.
• Dependencias y roadmap inicial.
• Supuestos y niveles de confianza.

Los cálculos y el scoring deben ser determinísticos, versionados y trazables. Los mismos inputs, reglas y versiones deben producir el mismo resultado. La IA no debe inventar cifras ni reemplazar las fórmulas.

5. Integración de inteligencia artificial

Se utilizará una API de IA para resumir y clasificar información, relacionar respuestas de varios stakeholders, detectar vacíos o contradicciones, preparar preguntas de aclaración y crear borradores de oportunidades, explicaciones y narrativas ejecutivas.

Los outputs deben ser estructurados, editables y vinculados con la evidencia. El equipo interno debe poder aprobarlos, rechazarlos o ajustarlos antes de compartirlos.

La solución debe registrar prompts, modelo utilizado, fuentes, confianza, resultados y cambios humanos, además de controlar errores, consumo y costos de API. Las credenciales permanecerán protegidas en el backend y la información de clientes no podrá utilizarse para entrenamiento.

6. Panel administrativo

El equipo interno debe poder administrar:

• Usuarios, organizaciones y engagements.
• Preguntas, respuestas y lógica condicional.
• Contenidos en español e inglés.
• Madurez, scoring, pesos y thresholds.
• Fórmulas y parámetros de valor.
• Catálogo de casos de uso.
• Criterios de priorización.
• Prompts y versiones.
• Textos de resultados y reportes.
• Ajustes manuales, notificaciones, errores y consumo de APIs.

Los cambios de configuración deben conservar fecha, versión y responsable.

7. Resultados y reporte ejecutivo

La aplicación debe generar una vista ejecutiva y un reporte descargable en PDF con:

• Perfil de madurez y principales brechas.
• Mapa de oportunidades.
• Cinco oportunidades priorizadas.
• Business cases de alto nivel.
• Supuestos y nivel de confianza.
• Roadmap inicial.
• Recomendación y siguientes decisiones.

El reporte se generará en español o inglés, utilizará la identidad visual suministrada y requerirá aprobación interna antes de quedar disponible para el cliente.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS Y DE SEGURIDAD

• Arquitectura multiempresa con separación segura de datos.
• Acceso basado en roles.
• Cifrado en tránsito y almacenamiento.
• Backups y recuperación.
• Registro de errores y actividad.
• Exportación y eliminación de información.
• Ambientes de desarrollo, pruebas y producción.
• Aplicación privada desktop-first y diagnóstico adaptable a móvil.
• APIs y credenciales protegidas.
• Código y componentes documentados.
• Dependencias, plugins y licencias identificados.

El MVP tendrá inicialmente un uso controlado. No necesita infraestructura masiva, pero la arquitectura no debe impedir su evolución.

ARQUITECTURA PROPUESTA

El candidato deberá explicar:

• Stack, base de datos y hosting.
• Procesos ejecutados en el backend.
• Integración con IA y documentos.
• Generación de reportes.
• Seguridad entre organizaciones.
• Versionamiento de reglas y cálculos.
• Escalabilidad y mantenimiento.
• Costos mensuales de infraestructura, licencias y APIs.
• Riesgos de dependencia tecnológica.
• Forma de transferir la solución al cliente.

La plataforma no se seleccionará solamente por velocidad. También se evaluarán mantenibilidad, seguridad, flexibilidad y costo total de propiedad.

ENTREGABLES

1. Discovery y especificación funcional definitiva.
2. Arquitectura, modelo de datos y flujos.
3. Wireframes y diseño responsive.
4. MVP funcional en ambiente de pruebas.
5. Integraciones de IA, correo y almacenamiento.
6. Pruebas funcionales y soporte para User Acceptance Testing.
7. Correcciones y despliegue en producción.
8. Código, configuración y activos en cuentas del cliente.
9. Documentación técnica y administrativa.
10. Transferencia de conocimiento.
11. Garantía mínima de treinta días para errores.
12. Cotización separada de mantenimiento y evoluciones.

FUERA DEL ALCANCE INICIAL

Página corporativa, aplicación móvil nativa, pagos, integración completa con CRM, gestión de proyectos posteriores, videollamadas, colaboración simultánea, entrenamiento de un modelo propio, OCR avanzado y análisis autónomo de modelos complejos de Excel.

INFORMACIÓN PROPORCIONADA POR EL CLIENTE

El cliente entregará metodología, preguntas iniciales, dimensiones de madurez, fórmulas, criterios de comparación, catálogo de casos de uso, prompts, ejemplos de outputs, contenidos bilingües, identidad visual y acceso a un experto de negocio.

CONFIDENCIALIDAD Y PROPIEDAD

La metodología detallada, preguntas, fórmulas, prompts y templates se compartirán únicamente con candidatos preseleccionados bajo acuerdo de confidencialidad.

La solución, código, configuración, diseños, datos y activos serán propiedad del cliente. El trabajo deberá realizarse en cuentas controladas por el cliente o transferirse completamente antes del cierre. No se permitirá reutilizar o comercializar la metodología ni los componentes específicos del producto.

CONTENIDO OBLIGATORIO DE LA OFERTA

La propuesta debe incluir:

1. Experiencia y ejemplos verificables de Web Apps B2B.
2. Experiencia integrando IA mediante APIs.
3. Arquitectura recomendada y justificación.
4. Equipo y responsabilidad de cada participante.
5. Plan, tiempo y precio por hitos.
6. Precio separado para discovery.
7. Supuestos y exclusiones.
8. Costos mensuales estimados.
9. Estrategia de pruebas, seguridad y respaldo.
10. Soporte posterior al lanzamiento.
11. Riesgos o aspectos que requieren mayor definición.
12. Disponibilidad para entrevista y confidencialidad.

Responder también:

• ¿Cómo implementaría un motor configurable, versionado y trazable?
• ¿Cómo separaría cálculos determinísticos y análisis de IA?
• ¿Cómo impediría el acceso cruzado entre organizaciones?
• ¿Cómo manejaría la revisión humana y el historial de cambios?
• ¿Cuál considera que es la parte más riesgosa?

Se valorará una estimación realista y sustentada. La oferta debe separar el precio de discovery del costo estimado de construcción del MVP.

The purpose of this platform is to integrate with our merger distributors (Afrox, Oryx, EasyGas, Total) and provide consumers nationwide a seamless solution for purchasing LPG gas cylinders (9kg, 19kg, and 48kg) at discounted prices.

Key Features Required:
- User-friendly mobile app interface with responsive design.
- Website complementing app functionality.
- API integration with supplier systems for real-time inventory and pricing updates.
- Customer dashboards for personalized account management.
- Order management from placement to fulfillment, with delivery tracking.
- Payment gateway integrations supporting secure and diverse payment options.
- National delivery mapping and route optimization.
- Intelligent AI automation for enhanced operations and user engagement.
- Finance tools with Xero accounting software integration.
- Partner and admin dashboards for streamlined coordination.
- Analytics and reporting features for decision-making support.
- Robust security measures to protect data integrity and user privacy.
- AI-driven customer support system.

Additional Deliverables:
- Comprehensive testing and quality assurance protocols.
- Deployment plan ensuring optimized rollout across all platforms (iOS, Android, Web).

Ideal Candidate:
Proven expertise in AI integration, web/mobile app development, API synchronization, payment systems, analytics tools, and robust database infrastructure. The ability to deliver within tightly defined milestones is essential.

items.title: Senior AI Blockchain Lead Developer
items.description:
I’m looking for a seasoned engineer who can take full ownership of our AI-driven blockchain initiatives and guide a cross-functional team from concept to production. Day to day, you will architect and code scalable smart-contract systems, integrate AI models that enhance trading strategies, and make sure every release is secure, gas-efficient, and ready for real-world volume.

You’ll work hands-on in Solidity, Rust, Go, Python, and the usual web3 stack—Hardhat, Foundry, web3.js, ethers.js—as well as AI frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch when we layer machine-learning components on-chain or in supporting micro-services. Whether the solution calls for Ethereum, Layer-2 rollups, Polkadot parachains, or a Hyperledger consortium network, you’ll decide on the best fit, document the trade-offs, and lead implementation.

Core deliverables I’ll hold you accountable for:
• A production-ready blockchain architecture diagram with security considerations clearly marked  
• Audited smart-contract code and deployment scripts with full test coverage  
• A lightweight dApp or API gateway that surfaces key functionality to internal traders and external partners  
• Post-launch monitoring dashboards and a knowledge base that sets the standard for future teams  

Acceptance criteria: contracts pass static analysis and third-party audit, main-net deployments settle without re-entrancy or overflow issues, AI modules meet the performance benchmarks we’ll define together, and documentation enables another senior engineer to take over with minimal ramp-up.

If you thrive in fast-moving crypto markets, enjoy pairing deep protocol expertise with practical product thinking, and want to ship game-changing tech, let’s discuss how soon you can start.

Skills: Java, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, Blockchain, Rust, Solidity, Smart Contracts

items.title: Full-Stack Development for Travel Agency Website, Booking, Quotation & Payment Platform
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer or development team to upgrade our existing travel agency website, **FlySmart**, into a modern, scalable travel website and management platform.

Current website: **https://flysmart.sa**

The project is not just a website redesign. We need a proper backend/admin system that allows us to manage travel products, customer quotations, payments, invoices, and destination content.

### Main Requirements

**1. Corporate Website**

* Modern, premium, mobile-first design
* Arabic RTL support
* Home, About, Services, Contact, Licenses, Terms, Privacy Policy, etc.
* Fast loading and optimized user experience
* Maintain and improve the existing FlySmart brand identity

**2. Products & Services**
We need to create and manage travel products such as:

* Visa services
* Travel packages
* Tour programs
* Honeymoon packages
* Seasonal travel offers
* Other travel services

Customers should be able to view, request, and purchase selected services directly from the website.

**3. Admin Dashboard**
We need a powerful admin dashboard to manage:

* Products
* Customers
* Orders
* Payments
* Invoices
* Travel offers / quotations
* Destination reports
* Website content
* Media and files
* User roles and permissions

**4. Custom Travel Quotation System**
This is one of the most important parts of the project.

Our staff should be able to create a customized travel offer for a customer by adding:

* Customer details
* Flights
* Airlines and flight details
* Hotels
* Room types
* Ground transportation
* Drivers
* Tours and activities
* Daily itinerary
* Included / excluded services
* Final price
* VAT
* Offer expiration date

After creating the offer, the system should generate a private link such as:

`flysmart.sa/offer/XXXXXX`

The customer can open the link, review the full travel offer, approve it, and proceed to payment.

Offer statuses should include:
Draft, Sent, Viewed, Approved, Pending Payment, Paid, Expired, Cancelled.

**5. Online Payments**
Integration with **Paymob Payment Gateway** using their official API:

https://developers.paymob.com/paymob-docs/integration-paths/apis

The integration must include:

* Backend API integration
* Payment Intention
* Webhooks
* HMAC verification
* Transaction validation
* Payment status management
* Sandbox / production environments
* Secure handling of API credentials

The system must confirm successful payments using Paymob webhooks, not only the payment success redirect page.

**6. Invoices**
After successful payment:

* Generate an invoice automatically
* Store the invoice in the admin system
* Allow PDF download
* Link the invoice to the customer, order, payment, VAT, and service

**7. Travel Destination Content**
We currently create detailed travel destination reports manually.

We need to manage these reports from the admin dashboard.

Each destination can contain:

* Country information
* Visa information
* Currency
* Language
* Safety
* Best travel season
* Advantages / disadvantages
* Airports
* Airlines
* Transportation
* Trains
* Suggested itineraries
* Cities
* Attractions
* Recommended hotels
* Images
* Google Maps links
* Travel tips

Each destination should have an SEO-friendly page such as:

`flysmart.sa/destinations/poland`

**8. SEO**
The website must follow Google SEO best practices, including:

* SEO titles and descriptions
* Canonical URLs
* XML Sitemap
* robots.txt
* Structured Data / Schema
* Breadcrumbs
* 301 redirects
* Editable URL slugs
* Image alt text
* Internal linking
* Core Web Vitals
* Mobile performance optimization

**9. Analytics & Advertising Tracking**
Integration with:

* Google Analytics 4
* Google Tag Manager
* Google Search Console
* Google Ads Conversion Tracking
* TikTok Pixel
* X Pixel

The website should also support UTM tracking and conversion events such as:

* Lead submission
* WhatsApp click
* Product view
* Offer view
* Offer approval
* Begin checkout
* Purchase

We want to track the full customer journey from advertising campaign to completed payment.

**10. Scalability**
The system must be database-driven and built with a clean, scalable architecture.

We may later add:

* Customer accounts
* CRM
* Supplier management
* Visa document uploads
* WhatsApp API
* SMS
* Loyalty program
* Hotel APIs
* Airline APIs
* Mobile app

Therefore, we do not want a solution based on manually created HTML pages or a system that will need to be rebuilt later.

### Before Starting

Please include in your proposal:

* Recommended technology stack
* Proposed system architecture
* Similar projects you have completed
* Experience with payment gateway/API integration
* Experience with SEO and analytics tracking
* Estimated development timeline
* Milestones
* What you recommend for Phase 1 vs Phase 2
* Post-launch warranty/support period

We are looking for someone interested in building a **long-term, professional platform**, not only completing a basic website redesign.

Please only apply if you have relevant Full-Stack development experience and can handle backend development, database design, payment APIs, admin dashboards, and frontend development.

Skills: PHP, SEO, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Laravel, React.js, Payment Gateway Integration, Full Stack Development, API Integration, Next.js

items.title: Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer
items.description:
Project Title: Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer to build, operate, and continuously improve a large-scale production data acquisition and document processing system.

Project Type: Long-term / Ongoing
Engagement: Full-time
Experience Required: 5+ years
Location: On-site / Hybrid

About the Project

We collect large volumes of publicly available documents and structured records from hundreds of external web sources every day.

The sources are highly inconsistent and frequently change their website structure, formats, URLs, APIs, and document layouts. A significant portion of the data also comes from scanned PDFs, images, and other difficult-to-process documents.

We need someone who can take end-to-end ownership of the entire data acquisition pipeline, including web scraping, crawling, document downloading, OCR, data extraction, structuring, validation, quality assurance, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

This is not a one-time scraping project. We are looking for someone with proven experience building and maintaining production-grade extraction pipelines at scale.

Key Responsibilities

1. Web Scraping & Data Acquisition

Build and maintain large-scale crawlers across hundreds of websites and external data sources.
Handle dynamic websites, JavaScript rendering, pagination, sessions, cookies, tokens, forms, and file downloads.
Work with technologies such as Python, Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, Requests/httpx, etc.
Implement rate limiting, retries, backoff, and request management.
Build incremental crawling and change-detection mechanisms.
Detect website/source changes and quickly fix broken extractors.
Ensure data is collected completely, accurately, and on schedule.

2. OCR & Document Processing

Process large volumes of native PDFs, scanned PDFs, images, and other document formats.
Build and optimize OCR pipelines for poor-quality documents.
Handle skewed/rotated pages, faded text, stamps, seals, watermarks, handwriting, and complex layouts.
Apply image preprocessing such as deskewing, denoising, binarization, cropping, and image enhancement.
Extract structured information from complex tables, including merged cells, multi-page tables, borderless tables, and nested headers.
Process multilingual documents, including Indian regional languages.
Benchmark and select appropriate OCR engines based on document type and accuracy.

3. Data Extraction & Structuring

Convert unstructured web/document content into structured datasets.
Design and maintain data schemas.
Use rules, regex, layout-aware extraction, NLP/NER, and LLM-assisted extraction where appropriate.
Normalize dates, amounts, units, names, addresses, identifiers, and other inconsistent values.
Implement deduplication and entity resolution.
Maintain taxonomies, classification logic, and reference/master data.

4. Data Quality & Validation

Build automated quality checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness, consistency, uniqueness, and validity.
Implement validation and anomaly-detection mechanisms.
Maintain gold-standard datasets and benchmark extraction/OCR accuracy.
Create human-in-the-loop review processes for low-confidence results.
Reconcile extracted data against the original source.
Maintain data lineage and audit trails so records can be traced back to the original source document and extraction run.

5. Production Operations

Build and operate reliable, scheduled production pipelines.
Use Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools.
Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, retries, and failure recovery.
Track uptime, throughput, latency, coverage, cost, and data quality.
Use Docker and CI/CD.
Troubleshoot production issues and prevent recurring failures.
Document the system, extraction logic, and operational procedures.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years of hands-on experience in production data extraction, web scraping, document processing, or data acquisition.
Strong Python programming and production engineering practices.
Strong experience with large-scale web scraping/crawling.
Experience with Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, Requests/httpx, or equivalent.
Deep practical OCR experience with Tesseract, PaddleOCR, EasyOCR, Google Document AI, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, or similar.
Strong PDF/document processing experience with PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, pdfminer, Camelot, Tabula, or equivalent.
Strong SQL and relational database knowledge.
PostgreSQL or equivalent database experience.
Experience with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar workflow orchestration.
Experience with AWS and/or GCP.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and alerting.
Strong understanding of data quality and automated testing.
Experience maintaining and improving production datasets over time.
Understanding of responsible and lawful web data collection, including robots.txt, terms of service, privacy, and applicable data protection requirements.
Good to Have
OpenCV and image processing
NLP / NER
LLM-based document extraction
Multilingual OCR
Indian regional language OCR
Entity resolution / record linkage
Data lineage and provenance
Great Expectations, Soda, Pandera, or similar
dbt and dbt tests
BigQuery
AWS S3, Lambda, Batch
GCP Cloud Storage
Distributed/batch processing
Experience with government, legal, financial, regulatory, or public-sector documents
Ideal Candidate

We are not looking for someone who has only built basic scraping scripts.

The ideal candidate should have experience operating a production system involving:

Hundreds of Sources → Crawling → Document Acquisition → OCR → Data Extraction → Structuring → Validation → QA → Production Dataset

You should understand common failure points such as website changes, broken selectors, missing documents, OCR errors, duplicate records, incorrect table extraction, silent pipeline failures, source downtime, and data quality degradation—and know how to build systems that detect and recover from these issues.

To Apply

Please send your CV along with a brief description of:

The largest scraping/document extraction pipeline you have personally managed.
Number of sources/websites handled.
Approximate daily/monthly volume of documents or records.
Types of documents processed.
Technologies and frameworks used.
Your measured OCR/extraction accuracy, if available.
How you measured and improved accuracy.
One example where a production pipeline failed silently, how you discovered it, and what you changed to prevent it from happening again.

Please provide specific numbers, technologies, and examples wherever possible. We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience operating large-scale, continuously running production data acquisition systems.

Skills: Python, Data Processing, Web Scraping, OCR, Scrapy, Data Scraping, Data Extraction, Data Management, Data Engineer, OCR Automation

I need a seasoned full-stack developer who can take a B2B SaaS concept from idea to live product. It will be a secure document collection and workflow platform built specifically for lenders and financial services companies. Think of a modern, better alternative to FileInvite.com, with lender-specific document templates and workflows.

The core product allows lenders to create customers, select or create document checklists, and send secure branded requests. Borrowers open a secure link, verify their identity, and upload required documents from desktop or mobile, including taking photos with their phone. Lenders can track progress, review documents, accept/reject or request replacements, communicate with customers, and send automated reminders. I will send you full guide.

You will:
• Build secure multi-tenant organization and user management with role-based permissions
• Build lender dashboard, customer management and document request workflows
• Build a simple mobile-first borrower portal
• Implement secure file uploads, storage, previews, document versioning and malware scanning
• Build document templates, reminders, notifications, messaging and audit logs

• Build the backend/API with PostgreSQL and scalable architecture
• Deploy the application to our VPS and provide clean, documented code in GitHub
• Ai capabilities
• Fully custom coded frontend and backend, no machine coding.

Security is critical because the platform will handle sensitive financial documents. The architecture must include strong tenant isolation, encryption, secure authentication, signed document URLs and comprehensive audit logging, with future SOC 2 readiness in mind.

The preferred stack is Next.js/React/TypeScript on the frontend, Node.js/TypeScript backend, PostgreSQL, and deployment to the VPS I provide.

# Location-Based Job & Employee Finding App – Turkey

We are looking for an experienced developer/team to build a **brand-new, original job and employee finding platform** for the Turkish market.

The project will start completely from scratch. We have **no prototype, no Figma design, no existing backend, no database and no source code**.

The project must be completed **end-to-end and published on both Google Play and Apple App Store**.

## PLATFORM

The mobile application must support:

* Android
* iOS

Our preferred technology is **Flutter**, using a shared codebase where appropriate.

The first phase will target **Turkey only**. The architecture should be scalable for future international expansion, but unnecessary international features are not required initially.

The application will be in Turkish and use TRY.

## IMPORTANT – NOT A CLONE

As a market reference, please review İşin Olsun:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.isinolsun.app

https://isinolsun.com/

This is **ONLY a functional/industry reference**.

We do NOT want a clone.

Do not copy its:

* Design
* UI/UX
* Screens
* Branding
* Logo
* Texts
* Images
* Source code
* User experience

Our application must have its own original brand, design, UI/UX, user flows, source code and architecture.

## UI/UX

UI/UX must be designed completely from scratch.

We want a modern, clean, fast and extremely user-friendly interface.

The user should be able to find and apply for a job with minimum steps.

Job seeker flow:

**Location → Nearby Jobs → Filter → Job Details → Apply**

Employer flow:

**Create Company → Create Job → Location → Publish → Applications → Contact Candidate**

Figma design must be prepared and approved before the main development starts.

## JOB SEEKER

Users should be able to register quickly without creating a traditional CV.

Profile can include:

* Name/surname
* Phone
* Photo
* Location
* City/district
* Profession
* Categories
* Experience
* Education
* Skills
* Work preferences
* Salary expectation
* About

Users must be able to search jobs by location and view them in both **list and map views**.

Location search must use real GPS coordinates and distance calculation.

Example:

**Show jobs within 5 km of my location.**

## JOB SEARCH & FILTERS

Support:

* Full-time
* Part-time
* Daily
* Hourly
* Freelance
* Temporary
* Remote

Filters should include:

* Category
* Location
* Distance
* Salary
* Work type
* New jobs
* Urgent jobs

## JOB DETAILS

Job details should include:

* Position
* Company
* Company profile
* Description
* Salary
* Work type
* Working hours
* Location
* Distance
* Requirements
* Experience
* Apply
* Favorite
* Report
* Contact employer

Users must be able to apply with **one simple action**.

## EMPLOYER

Employers can create company accounts and manage company profiles.

They can:

* Create/edit/delete job listings
* Publish free job listings
* View applications
* Manage applicants
* Search candidates by location
* Filter candidates
* View candidate profiles
* Contact candidates
* Message candidates

Candidate search should support location/distance, profession, category, experience and work preferences.

## MESSAGING & COMMUNICATION

Job seekers and employers must be able to communicate through:

* In-app messaging
* Phone calling where permitted

Messaging should include message history, push notifications and appropriate blocking/reporting functionality.

## FAVORITES & JOB ALERTS

Users can:

* Save favorite jobs
* Create job alerts based on category, location, distance, salary and work type

Matching new jobs should trigger push notifications.

## NOTIFICATIONS

Push notifications should support:

* New matching jobs
* Job alerts
* New messages
* Applications
* Application status
* Employer messages
* System announcements
* Account/security notifications

## URGENT & VERIFIED EMPLOYERS

The platform must include:

* Urgent job listings
* Verified employer system

Verification must be manageable from the admin panel.

Urgent listings should be designed so they can become a paid/promotional feature in the future.

## REPORTING

Users must be able to report:

* Jobs
* Companies
* Users
* Messages/content

Admins must be able to review reports and take action.

## ADMIN PANEL

A comprehensive web admin panel is required.

Admin should manage:

* Users
* Employers
* Companies
* Job listings
* Applications
* Categories/subcategories
* Reports
* Verified employers
* Urgent jobs
* Notifications
* User blocking
* Content moderation

Statistics should include items such as:

* Users
* Active users
* Employers
* Jobs
* Applications
* Popular categories
* Active cities
* Job performance

## LOCATION / MAP

Location is a core feature.

The system must support:

* GPS
* Latitude/longitude
* City/district
* Distance calculation
* Maps
* Nearby jobs
* Nearby candidates

The distance must be calculated from actual coordinates, not simply city/district matching.

Please specify which map provider you recommend and expected API costs.

## BACKEND & SECURITY

A secure and scalable backend/API and database must be developed from scratch.

Please include appropriate:

* Authentication
* Authorization
* API security
* Data validation
* Secure data transmission
* Rate limiting
* Logging
* Error handling
* Backup
* Database security

The system should be designed for future growth.

## INTEGRATIONS

All required integrations must be fully configured and working, including where applicable:

* Maps/GPS
* SMS/phone verification
* Push notifications
* Email
* Google services
* Apple services

Third-party accounts should preferably be created under our ownership/company accounts.

## TESTING

Complete testing is required before launch, including:

* Android
* iOS
* Different screen sizes/devices
* Registration/login
* Job posting
* Job search
* Filters
* GPS/maps
* Applications
* Messaging
* Notifications
* Employer features
* Admin panel
* API
* Security
* Performance

## APP STORE / GOOGLE PLAY

The project is not complete when coding is finished.

The developer/team must handle the technical process until the applications are successfully published on:

* Google Play Store
* Apple App Store

This includes production builds, submission support and fixing technical issues/rejections related to the application.

## SOURCE CODE & OWNERSHIP

At completion, we must receive all project files and source code:

* Flutter source code
* Android/iOS project files
* Backend source code
* Admin panel source code
* Database
* Figma files
* API documentation
* Technical documentation
* Deployment information

The project must not depend on developer-owned accounts or inaccessible proprietary code.

## DELIVERY

Preferred milestones:

1. Requirements & technical planning
2. UI/UX + Figma
3. Figma approval
4. Backend/database
5. Flutter Android/iOS
6. Employer system
7. Admin panel
8. Integrations
9. Testing/bug fixing
10. Production deployment
11. Google Play + App Store publication
12. Warranty/support

## PROPOSAL REQUIREMENTS

Please provide:

* Flutter experience
* Similar projects
* Published Google Play apps
* Published App Store apps
* Backend technology
* Admin panel technology
* Database technology
* UI/UX experience
* GPS/map experience
* Messaging experience
* Team information
* Total project price
* Development time
* Milestone/payment plan
* Free warranty period
* Post-launch support
* Third-party/API costs
* Anything NOT included in your price

Please quote for the **complete end-to-end scope** above.

We are looking for a **production-ready, original, modern, user-friendly and scalable platform**, not a simple demo.

**The project must be built from zero and delivered until it is live on both Google Play and Apple App Store.**

items.title: AI E-Commerce Sales Boost Platform
items.description:
My goal is to lift online revenue by building an e-commerce platform that serves each shopper a real-time, AI-driven stream of product suggestions. The entire architecture—from data ingestion to user-facing widgets—should be engineered around this single purpose: increasing sales through highly relevant recommendations.

Core functionality
The heart of the build is a personalised recommendation engine. It should analyse browsing behaviour, purchase history, and contextual signals to deliver on-page and in-email product suggestions that feel hand-picked for every visitor. While dynamic pricing and automated marketing campaigns may follow later, phase one focuses exclusively on perfecting these recommendations.

Technical expectations
•  End-to-end platform or plug-in capable of integrating with common stacks (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom React/Node, etc.).
•  Scalable data pipeline—batch and real-time—to capture events, train models, and serve predictions with low latency.
•  Model layer leveraging proven libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar) and techniques such as collaborative filtering and deep learning for cold-start mitigation.
•  Admin dashboard for A/B testing, rule overrides, and performance analytics (CTR, AOV lift, revenue attribution).

Deliverables
1. Deployed, production-ready storefront or extension with live product-suggestion widgets.
2. Source code repository with clean commit history and automated tests.
3. Infrastructure-as-code scripts (Docker/Kubernetes or equivalent) for reproducible deployment.
4. Documentation: setup guide, API spec, data schema, and a short walkthrough video.

Acceptance criteria
•  Recommendation latency under 200 ms at P95.
•  At least a 5 % uplift in click-through rate during pilot A/B test against a static control list.
•  No critical errors in load testing at 5× expected peak traffic.

Timeline is flexible within reason, provided milestones are met and performance targets are verifiable. I’m available throughout for dataset provisioning, brand assets, and iterative feedback.

Build a Scalable Local-First News & Digital Platform

Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer or Development Team to build a scalable digital platform focused on Tamil Nadu / local-first news and information.

The platform will combine a modern news portal with several complementary services, creating a single destination where users can discover news, jobs, events, marketplace listings and personalized local information.

This is a production application, not a basic news website or template-based project.

Core Features

News Platform

- Modern responsive news website

- India, World, Politics, Business, Sports, Cinema, Technology, Education, Jobs and other categories
- Breaking news
- Live story updates
- Featured, latest, popular and trending news

Newsroom / CMS

- Advanced admin dashboard

- Draft, review, approval and publishing workflow
- Scheduled publishing
- Reporter → Editor → Approval workflow
- Article revisions
- Media library

- Role-based permissions

SEO & Content Infrastructure

- Technical SEO
- News SEO
- Structured data
- XML/news sitemaps
- Robots.txt
- RSS feeds
- Canonical URLs
- AI-search/AEO-oriented content structure
- SEO management inside the CMS

Personalized Homepage

The homepage will combine news with useful daily information such as:

- Personalized/local content
- Location-based information
- Daily briefing
- Weather

User System

Marketplace

Jobs & Events

- Event discovery and filtering
- Location-based events

AI & Third-Party Integrations

The platform will integrate selected external services including AI and information APIs.

AI will primarily assist editors with SEO/content metadata generation, with human review and approval required before publication.

External services must be designed so that failure of one provider does not bring down the core website.

Technical Requirements

- Vite
- TypeScript

- Node.js
- NestJS preferred
- TypeScript
- REST API

- PostgreSQL

- AWS or comparable production cloud
- Docker
- Redis
- Background job/queue system
- CDN/object storage
- Cloudflare or equivalent

The developer may propose an alternative architecture if there is a strong technical reason.

---

Scalability & Reliability

The system must be designed for significant traffic growth.

Important requirements:

- Caching
- Background processing
- Queue-based external API processing
- Database optimization
- Proper error handling
- API timeouts/retries
- Graceful failure of third-party services
- Automated backups
- Monitoring and logging
- Security best practices
- Scalable deployment architecture

The website should continue operating even when individual external services are temporarily unavailable.

---

Ownership & Handover

Client must retain ownership/control of the following:

- Source code
- Git repository
- Database
- Cloud infrastructure
- Domain
- Third-party API accounts
- Deployment configuration
- Documentation

The application must not be designed in a way that creates dependency on a particular developer or company.

A future development team should be able to take over the project using the documentation, source code and infrastructure access.

---

Required Deliverables

- Complete frontend
- Complete backend
- Database
- API documentation
- Deployment configuration
- Production deployment
- Staging environment
- Testing
- Security implementation
- Automated backups
- Monitoring/logging

items.description:
Sports speaker bureau website rebuild or extension, with an AI-assisted content and speaker-management layer. This is a competitive RFP — a full 16-section written RFP is available on request.

WHO WE ARE
A US sports speaker bureau. We represent a large roster of professional and Olympic athletes and book them for corporate events, conferences, fundraisers and campus appearances. Our current public site runs on Strapi (Node).

PRICE BOTH OF THESE SEPARATELY
Option A — Extend the existing Strapi build: keep the CMS and content model, improve the front end, information architecture, SEO and speaker-management workflow, and add the AI layer.
Option B — Greenfield rebuild on a stack you recommend and can justify, with full content migration.
Bids that price only one option will not be evaluated. 

MANDATORY — THIS IS AN ELIGIBILITY GATE
The AI content and speaker-management layer is not an optional add-on. If you cannot deliver it, please do not bid. Answer these five questions directly in your bid:
1. Accuracy — how do you prevent fabricated biographical facts about a real person? What is your grounding approach?
2. Human review — what is the exact editorial workflow between generation and publication, and where does approval live in the CMS?
3. Rights and likeness — how do you handle image rights, photo credits and athlete approval of copy written about them?
4. Model provider — which provider(s), what happens to our content, and can we switch later without a rewrite?
5. Error handling — what happens when the model is unavailable, rate-limited, or returns something unusable mid-publish?

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- SEO is a primary business driver. Documented URL redirect map from the existing site, preserved rankings on our highest-traffic pages, structured data for people and events, per-page metadata control, working XML sitemap.
- Inquiry and booking forms integrate with our CRM. We are on GoHighLevel and evaluating HubSpot — handle either, and say what changes if we switch.
- WCAG 2.1 AA as a delivery requirement, not later remediation.
- Stated performance budgets and Core Web Vitals targets, tested before handover.
- First-party event tracking plus GA4.

OWNERSHIP AND RUN COSTS
- We own the source code outright at completion. No proprietary CMS we cannot leave.
- Handover includes documented local dev setup, deployment runbook and a working staging environment.
- Itemise ongoing monthly run costs separately from build cost: hosting, any CMS licence, AI/model usage at our expected volume, search, email, monitoring.
- Quote maintenance and support separately: response times, what is included, what is billed.

BUDGET
Maximum US $20,000 for the build. Propose your own milestone schedule with deliverables tied to payments.

INCLUDE IN YOUR BID
Two prices (A and B) and what differs; answers to the five AI questions; two or three live content-heavy, people-driven sites you built and your specific role on each; one SEO-preserving migration you ran and what traffic did afterwards; itemised monthly run costs; team composition and who we talk to weekly; timeline with milestones.

Copy-paste boilerplate bids will be ignored. We read every bid that engages with the questions above.
