items.description:
FINAL CONTINUATION — AI VIRTUAL EXPERIENCE CREATOR + FANVUE GROWTH PARTNER

This is the third and final continuation of my original job posts. Think of this as the final screening/interview.

If you applied before, please read this carefully. If this makes you MORE interested, contact me. If you cannot genuinely produce this level of work, please do not apply.

THIS IS AN EXPERIENCE — NOT A NORMAL FANVUE/ONLYFANS PAGE

I am building a high-end immersive virtual gentlemen’s-club experience, not a basic page selling random photos and videos.

Members should feel like they are actually entering a real luxury club, getting to know the woman at the center of it, progressing through different rooms and unlocking increasingly exclusive experiences.

The customer should constantly think: “What happens in the next room?”

WHO I AM / WHO SHE IS

The AI woman is based on ME — my likeness, personality and presence.

I am a model developing a supermodel-style AI twin based on myself. I am also a businesswoman running other companies and studying law.

She is beautiful and glamorous, but also smart, strong, sophisticated, confident, caring, understanding and flirtatious.

Members should feel that they actually get to know her. Some may be businessmen, executives, entrepreneurs or wealthy clients who have stressful days and simply want somewhere luxurious to unwind, have a drink, talk, flirt and relax.

The connection matters just as much as the visual experience.

THE ROOMS / PROGRESSION

$100 — THE LOUNGE + BAR

This is where members enter and begin getting to know her. Think beautiful luxury lounge/bar, drinks, conversation and flirting.

I already have still-image concepts showing her sitting at a bar with a gentleman naturally seen from behind in a suit, with other guests subtly in the background.

The viewer must feel HE IS ACTUALLY IN THE ROOM WITH HER, not looking at an AI woman placed in front of a fake background.

Around $250 — THE TEASE / ENTERTAINMENT ROOM

More playful and seductive while still maintaining the connection. Dancing, teasing, flirting, drinks and entertainment. This may include pole-dance-style and belly-dance entertainment.

THE CIGAR LOUNGE

Sophisticated, intimate, darker luxury atmosphere with drinks and the feeling of a private high-end club.

THE DANCE / POLE / ENTERTAINMENT EXPERIENCE

Realistic AI-human movement and video — not just still pictures.

THE BUBBLE ROOM

A more exclusive champagne/bubble-bath atmosphere where members feel they have been invited somewhere more private.

THE PURPLE RAIN / VICHY SHOWER ROOM

A signature premium experience with water, movement, beautiful lighting and cinematic atmosphere.

There will be additional premium rooms and concepts shared only with the person selected.

Every room must feel like part of ONE REAL CLUB. The architecture, lighting, atmosphere and character must remain consistent. We may use immersive/POV-style perspectives, background guests and adult male guests naturally seen from behind or in silhouette so the member feels physically present.

MEMBERSHIP / STATUS PROGRESSION

The customer journey is approximately:

$100 → $250 → $500 → $1,000 → $1,500 SUGAR DADDY STATUS

Fanvue has platform pricing limits, so higher spending levels may use membership plus premium/PPV experiences.

Someone who can comfortably afford $100 should be able to enter and then WANT to see what the $250 experience unlocks, then the next level.

At the highest end, Sugar Daddy Status is intended for affluent/high-net-worth clientele, potentially including multimillionaire-level customers who can comfortably afford a highly exclusive premium monthly experience.

They are NOT paying more simply to receive more pictures.

They are paying to unlock a deeper level of the EXPERIENCE.

THIS IS NOT A 1–7 DAY PROJECT

I keep seeing bids saying 1 day, 3 days or 7 days.

That is NOT how this works.

Yes, I need someone FAST. I want enough of the first experience built within the next few weeks to begin accepting approximately $100 memberships within one month maximum.

Ideally, we launch the first level while already building the $250 experience behind it.

But the work continues indefinitely. Members cannot receive the same content every month.

We will continually need new videos, scenes, outfits, conversations, entertainment, special events, premium experiences, social content and eventually additional rooms.

More content = more work = more milestones = continued paid work.

HOW MILESTONES WILL WORK

Finalists may first receive a small $10 PAID TEST.

Then we will test the waters during the first few working stages.

For example, I may tell you:

“The first room is The Lounge. This is the experience I want. Tell me how YOU would bring it to life.”

I will give you the vision. I need YOU to know how to execute it.

I will be evaluating:

quality, realism, creativity, speed, how much meaningful work you deliver, communication, reliability and how independently you work.

How you perform during those first stages will help determine the pace, frequency, scope and value of future milestones as we continue.

I am NOT paying separately for every picture, video or individual scene. We will work through meaningful development/content milestones.

As I see how you work and what you deliver, we can increase the pace and value of milestone work. Substantial milestone work will be agreed before each next phase begins.

If you are excellent:

Build → approve → next room → next milestone → launch → more content → grow → continue.

BONUSES + COMMISSIONS

I reward excellent work. If I see exceptional quality, initiative, reliability and someone genuinely helping make this vision successful, I also give performance bonuses at my discretion.

The bigger additional earning opportunity comes from social-media growth and paying memberships.

I need someone who can create social content that makes people stop and think:

“What is this? I need to see inside.”

I want real paying customers, not fake followers.

There will be commissions tied to verified paying members you help generate.

For example:

10 new verified $100 members = commission opportunity.

Another 10 = another commission opportunity.

And higher-value customers create greater commission opportunities. Successfully helping bring members into approximately $250, $500, $1,000 and ultimately $1,500 Sugar Daddy experiences obviously creates substantially more value.

Exact commissions will be discussed with the person selected once we begin working together and see actual results.

The more this business grows, the greater the earning opportunity for the person helping me build and grow it.

I WILL NOT TRAIN OR BABYSIT

I am a busy businesswoman running other companies and managing multiple responsibilities.

I do not have time to train, babysit, micromanage or hold someone’s hand.

I will tell you the room, the feeling and what I want the member to experience.

You need to already know how to make it happen professionally.

I absolutely welcome strong ideas that could make this more immersive, exciting, profitable or unique. I want somebody who contributes ideas and solutions — not another job for me to manage.

SHOW ME RELEVANT WORK ONLY

Please do NOT send random websites, logos, cartoons or unrelated portfolios.

Whenever Freelancer allows it, send relevant examples directly in Freelancer messages/attachments so I can immediately see them.

I need to see:

• Photorealistic AI humans
• The SAME AI woman consistent across scenes
• Realistic AI-human video and movement
• AI humans inside believable luxury environments
• Immersive/POV/cinematic work
• Fanvue or similar platform experience
• Social-media growth work

FINAL QUESTIONS

1. How would YOU build The Lounge experience?
2. How would you make the viewer feel he is actually inside it?
3. How quickly can you make the first $100 experience launch-ready?
4. Show me your best photorealistic AI-human work and consistent character work.
5. Show me realistic AI-human video and environments.
6. What Fanvue experience do you have?
7. How would you turn social-media curiosity into paying members?
8. What would you contribute creatively without changing my core vision?
9. If your bid says 1–7 days, exactly what are you proposing to accomplish in that timeframe?

If you read this and think:

“I understand exactly what she is building. I have the ability. I see the potential and I want to grow with it.”

Then show me why I should choose you.

items.title: Urgent Job Fair Brochure
items.description:
Project Overview :
I am the organizer of "Mayotte Recrute" , the leading employment, careers, and attractiveness fair in Mayotte. We are preparing for our 2nd edition in 2026, which is critical for the island's reconstruction after Cyclones Chido and Dikeledi.

Mission: I need a professional Graphic Designer to redesign our 8-page commercial brochure. The goal is to sell exhibition stands to companies and recruiters.

Deadline: EXTREMELY URGENT. I need this delivered in 24 hours. I am looking for someone available immediately.

Requirement: I am looking for a true designer (who draws/creates) , not someone who will simply use AI to generate a generic template. I need a human with a strong eye for layout, hierarchy, and visual persuasion.

Design Objectives
SELL STANDS: The primary goal is to convert readers into exhibitors. The design must be persuasive, professional, and dynamic.
Tone: Clean, and airy. Must feel fresh and easy to read. (The 2024 version was too dense and cluttered).
Persuasiveness: Every page must visually push the reader to want to book a stand.

CREDIBILITY: The brochure needs to establish trust. It must highlight our 2024 success (real photos, stats, testimonials) to prove the event works.

URGENCY: The call-to-action (Page 8) must be strong and immediate.

Brand Guidelines & Assets
- Colors: We are not changing the color palette. Please use the same colors as the existing 2024 brochure (dominant blue and orange/red accents).
- Logo: The logo is not yet finalized. Please use the provided versions. You can suggest a new logo. It can be part 
- Fonts: I am open to changing the fonts to improve modernity and readability. I trust your expertise to suggest a better pairing than the previous version.

Assets Provided:
- Content brief (PDF/Doc) with text for all 8 pages.
- Existing 2024 brochure (PDF) for reference.
- Logos (multiple versions).
- graphical chart.
- real photos.

Page-by-Page Content Summary
- Page 1: Cover. Main Title: Salon MAYOTTE RECRUTE (Using the new logo)
Subtitle: 2e ÉDITION | 2026 | SALON DE L'EMPLOI, DES MÉTIERS ET DE L'ATTRACTIVITÉ POUR SA RECONSTRUCTION
Dates: 23 & 24 OCTOBRE 2026

- Page 2: Who We Are (Credibility)
cf content.

- Page 3: 2024 Success (Proof - THE MOST IMPORTANT PAGE)
It can be done on a double page
Title: 8 & 9 NOVEMBRE 2024 : UNE 1re ÉDITION QUI A TENU SES PROMESSES
Key Stats: 900+ visitors, 34 exhibitors, etc.
Satisfaction: 100% exhibitors satisfied.
Testimonials: 3 impactful quotes.
Visuals: REAL PHOTOS only (provided). NO stock photos.

Page 4: 2026 Edition (New Objectives)
Title: 2026 : UNE ÉDITION DÉDIÉE À LA RECONSTRUCTION
the reconstruction thematic must appear in the design. We have to feel this reconstruction point. Please note that reconstruction concerns all fields (health, social, industry, etc., not only construction which is, of course, a huge part).
Targets: 1000+ visitors, 50 exhibitors, 200 job dating meetings.

Page 5: Trust & Partners
Logos: Co-financers, Gold Sponsors, Steering Committee.

Page 6: Program
Title: 2 JOURS, 4 DEMI-JOURNÉES, UN RYTHME CONTINU
Requirement: Clear and readable schedule. Color-coded by category (Conferences, Workshops, Job Dating).

Page 7: Packs & Prices (THE SELLING PAGE)
Title: CHOISISSEZ VOTRE NIVEAU DE PRÉSENCE
Format: A single, clear comparative table (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Note: The 2025 version was a disaster (hard to read). Most of the people did not undertand the tarifs. This must be improved.
The table must be visually intuitive. Recruiters should understand in 5 seconds what they get for each price level.
Communication: All communication benefits are integrated into the table (not a separate section).

Page 8: Call to Action / Back Cover
Title: RÉSERVEZ VOTRE STAND
CTA: Strong reasons to sign up, contact details, QR Codes, and legal mentions.

Ideal Candidate
Must be available right now for an immediate start.
Proven experience in corporate/brochure design.
Strong portfolio demonstrating clean, modern, and structured layouts.
Skilled in typography and layout hierarchy.
Responsive and able to work under a tight deadline.

Version française : 
Je cherche un designer disponible IMMÉDIATEMENT pour livrer la plaquette EN 24H. Ne postulez que si vous êtes disponible maintenant.

Présentation du projet
Je suis l'organisateur du Salon Mayotte Recrute, le plus grand salon de l'emploi, des métiers et de l'attractivité à Mayotte. Nous préparons notre 2e édition en 2026, essentielle pour la reconstruction de l'île après les cyclones Chido et Dikeledi.

Mission : Concevoir une plaquette commerciale de 8 pages pour vendre des stands aux entreprises et recruteurs.

Objectif : Cette plaquette doit être moderne, élégante et aérée (la version 2024 était trop dense). Chaque page doit donner envie de réserver un stand.

Exigences de design
Ton : Moderne, dynamique, épuré et facile à lire.
Persuasif : Chaque élément visuel doit pousser le lecteur à passer à l'action.
Couleurs : On conserve la charte existante (bleu dominant + touches orange/rouge). Pas de changement.
Logo : Pas encore finalisé. Je fournis les versions actuelles. Vous pouvez proposer une amélioration/re-design (dans la même charte).
Polices : Je suis ouvert à changer les polices pour plus de modernité et de lisibilité. Faites-vous confiance.

Contenu par page (8 pages)
Page 1 - Couverture
Titre : Salon MAYOTTE RECRUTE (avec le nouveau logo)
Sous-titre : 2e ÉDITION | 2026 | SALON DE L'EMPLOI, DES MÉTIERS ET DE L'ATTRACTIVITÉ POUR SA RECONSTRUCTION
Dates : 23 & 24 OCTOBRE 2026

Page 2 - Qui sommes-nous (Crédibilité)
Présentation de l'association
3 blocs : Connecter, Outiller, Préparer
Chiffres clés, valeurs

Page 3 - Édition 2024 (LA PAGE LA PLUS IMPORTANTE)
Titre : 8 & 9 NOVEMBRE 2024 : UNE 1re ÉDITION QUI A TENU SES PROMESSES
Statistiques : 900+ visiteurs, 34 exposants, etc.
Satisfaction : 100 % des exposants satisfaits
Verbatims : 3 témoignages impactants
Visuels : PHOTOS RÉELLES UNIQUEMENT (fournies). AUCUNE photo banque d'images.

Page 4 - Édition 2026 (Nouveautés)
Titre : 2026 : UNE ÉDITION DÉDIÉE À LA RECONSTRUCTION
Objectifs : 1 000+ visiteurs, 50 exposants, 200 job datings
Nouveautés : salon en ligne 3D, ateliers interactifs, parcours renforcé

Page 5 - Ils nous font confiance
Logos des co-financeurs, partenaires Gold, comité de pilotage

Page 6 - Programme
Titre : 2 JOURS, 4 DEMI-JOURNÉES, UN RYTHME CONTINU
Exigence : Grille horaire claire et lisible. Code couleur par type d'activité (Conférence / Atelier / Job dating / Temps officiel).
Note : La version 2024 était illisible. La nouvelle grille doit être compréhensible même sur petit écran.

Page 7 - Packs & Tarifs (LA PAGE VENDANTE)
Titre : CHOISISSEZ VOTRE NIVEAU DE PRÉSENCE
Format : Un tableau comparatif unique et clair (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
CRITIQUE : La version 2024 était incompréhensible. Les recruteurs doivent comprendre en 5 secondes ce qu'ils obtiennent pour chaque tarif.
Tous les avantages communication sont intégrés dans le tableau (pas de section séparée).

Page 8 - Appel à l'action (4e de couverture)
Titre : RÉSERVEZ VOTRE STAND
3 raisons de signer maintenant
Coordonnées commerciales, QR Codes, mentions légales

Profil du designer idéal
Disponible IMMÉDIATEMENT pour une livraison aujourd'hui.
Vrai designer humain (pas d'utilisation d'IA pour générer la mise en page).
Expérience prouvée en design de plaquettes/brochures.
Portfolio montrant des layouts propres, modernes et structurés.
Expert en typographie et hiérarchie visuelle.
Réactif et capable de travailler sous pression.

Skills: Graphic Design, Photoshop, Branding, Typography, Advertising, Brochure Design, Flyer Design, Creative Design, Visual Design, Print Design
